entries.baee97087d886eef: This is the company group's only business, consisting of the company and one consolidated subsidiary (Takahashi Seimen Co., Ltd.), two companies in total. It manufactures and sells a wide range of foods that pursue safety and nutritional value, and its revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,751 million. The company plans, develops and sells foods that are “safe,” “delicious” and “nutritionally valuable,” while Takahashi Seimen Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing instant noodles. Its head office is in Kanagawa Ward, Yokohama City, and the consolidated number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 38. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
